# BookBot API

AI-powered book search and download service.

## Resources

- **POST /api/x402** ($0.50) — Get a download link to the epub version of any book (full agent pipeline)
- **POST /api/x402/tools/scrape-books** ($0.10) — Search for books on Anna's Archive
- **POST /api/x402/tools/get-download-link** ($0.10) — Get the direct download link for a specific book

## Usage

All endpoints accept JSON bodies. The main `/api/x402` endpoint runs the full agent to find and return a download link. The tool endpoints can be used individually for more granular control.
